name: MonarchFileUpload
title: FileUpload
summary: An area for adding files through the system document picker, the system photo picker and drag and drop, with checks of type, size and count that explain every refusal.
whenToUse: Wherever people attach files that the app then uploads: attachments on a form, documents for a record, an avatar.
whenNotToUse: Not for showing upload progress (use MonarchUploadQueue), not for files already attached (use MonarchFileList or MonarchAttachmentChip), and not when the app only needs a photo with no checks (use PhotosPicker directly).
api: init(allowedContentTypes: [UTType] = [.item], maxSize: Int64? = nil, maxFiles: Int? = nil, currentCount: Int = 0, hint: String? = nil, systemImage: String? = nil, variant: MonarchFileUploadVariant = .zone, allowsMultipleSelection: Bool? = nil, allowsPhotos: Bool = false, showsErrors: Bool = true, isInvalid: Bool = false, labels: MonarchFileUploadLabels = MonarchFileUploadLabels(), validate: (@Sendable (MonarchFileUploadFile) -> String?)? = nil, onFiles: @escaping @MainActor ([MonarchFileUploadFile], [MonarchFileUploadRejection]) -> Void)

nonisolated static func validate(_ files: [MonarchFileUploadFile], allowedContentTypes: [UTType] = [.item], maxSize: Int64? = nil, maxFiles: Int? = nil, currentCount: Int = 0, labels: MonarchFileUploadLabels = MonarchFileUploadLabels(), locale: Locale = .autoupdatingCurrent, validate: (@Sendable (MonarchFileUploadFile) -> String?)? = nil) -> (accepted: [MonarchFileUploadFile], rejected: [MonarchFileUploadRejection])

struct MonarchFileUploadFile: Hashable, Sendable { let url: URL; let name: String; let size: Int64?; let contentType: UTType?; init(url: URL, name: String, size: Int64? = nil, contentType: UTType? = nil); init(url: URL) }
struct MonarchFileUploadRejection: Hashable, Sendable { let file: MonarchFileUploadFile; let reason: MonarchFileUploadRejectionReason; let message: String }
enum MonarchFileUploadRejectionReason { case invalidType, tooLarge, tooMany, custom }

struct MonarchFileUploadLabels { init(title: String? = nil, browse: String? = nil, photos: String? = nil, dropHere: String? = nil, invalidType: (@Sendable (String) -> String)? = nil, tooLarge: (@Sendable (String, String) -> String)? = nil, tooMany: (@Sendable (String, Int) -> String)? = nil, limits: (@Sendable (String?, Int?) -> String)? = nil, limitReached: (@Sendable (Int) -> String)? = nil, added: (@Sendable (Int) -> String)? = nil) }

options.name: allowedContentTypes
options.description: The accepted types, matched by conformance (.image accepts PNG and HEIC). The document picker shows only these.

options.name: maxSize
options.description: The largest size of one file, in bytes.

options.name: maxFiles
options.description: The most files in total, counting currentCount. Extra files are refused in order, keeping the first valid ones.

options.name: currentCount
options.description: Files already attached. When it reaches maxFiles the buttons are disabled and the hint says the limit is reached.

options.name: hint
options.description: Text under the title. By default it is made from the limits, such as "Up to 10 MB each · 5 files max".

options.name: systemImage
options.description: A decorative SF Symbol at the start. Default square.and.arrow.up.

options.name: variant
options.description: zone: a dashed bordered area with the parts stacked and centred. compact: one row; stacked at the accessibility text sizes.

options.name: allowsMultipleSelection
options.description: Whether several files can be chosen at once. By default yes, unless maxFiles is 1.

options.name: allowsPhotos
options.description: Adds "Choose photos", which opens PhotosPicker for the images and videos the allowed types accept.

options.name: showsErrors
options.description: Shows the refusals in a danger MonarchInlineNotice under the area. Turn off to show them yourself.

options.name: isInvalid
options.description: Draws the danger border, for example when a required file is missing.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in text and message.

options.name: validate
options.description: An extra check after type and size. Return a message to refuse the file.

options.name: onFiles
options.description: Receives the accepted and refused files of every pick or drop. The app uploads the accepted files.

states.name: rest
states.description: Surface fill with the input border; the zone's border is dashed.

states.name: drag over
states.description: While files are dragged over it (iPad, Mac): the accent subtle fill and accent border, and the title says "Drop to upload".

states.name: refused files
states.description: The danger border and a danger notice listing each refusal; announced.

states.name: limit reached
states.description: currentCount reached maxFiles: the disabled roles, disabled buttons and "Limit reached: 5 files attached."

states.name: loading photos
states.description: The photo button shows a progress indicator while the chosen photos are copied.

states.name: disabled
states.description: With .disabled(true): the disabled roles, and picking and dropping do nothing.

appearance: A container-radius area on the surface fill with an input-coloured border (dashed for the zone), a muted icon, the title in the label style and the hint in the muted caption style; buttons are MonarchButtonStyle secondary small. Drag over uses the accent subtle and accent border roles, errors the danger roles. Every colour is a theme role, so dark and high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web input's accept string becomes UTType values, matched by conformance. The browse button opens the system document picker (.fileImporter); its URLs are security-scoped, so the app calls startAccessingSecurityScopedResource() before reading. Photos and dropped files are copied to the temporary directory, because the system removes its copy when the import ends; the app deletes them after uploading. Dropping is available where the system supports drag and drop (iPad, Mac); on iPhone the buttons are the way in. The web's paste option and capture attribute have no direct equivalent: use MonarchFileUpload.validate for files the app gets from the pasteboard or the camera. The web greys out a drag of the wrong type before the drop; on iOS the type is known only after the drop, so the refusal comes then.
accessibility: "Browse files" and "Choose photos" are standard buttons with 44-point touch targets; they are the way in for VoiceOver and Switch Control.
The title and the hint are read as one element; the icon is decorative.
After a pick or drop, the number of files added and every refusal are announced.
Refusals are shown with a danger icon and text, not colour alone.
edgeCases: A file of unknown type is accepted only when any data is allowed; its type falls back to its extension first.
A file of unknown size passes the size check.
With single selection, extra dropped files are refused as "up to 1 file".
The refusals shown are those of the latest pick; a new pick replaces them.
A photo that cannot be loaded is skipped.

examples.title: With an upload queue
examples.template:
MonarchFileUpload(
    allowedContentTypes: [.image, .pdf],
    maxSize: {{maxSize}},
    maxFiles: {{maxFiles}},
    currentCount: attached.count,
    hint: {{hint}},
    labels: MonarchFileUploadLabels(title: {{title}}, browse: {{browse}})
) { accepted, _ in
    attached.append(contentsOf: accepted)
}
examples.code:
MonarchFileUpload(
    allowedContentTypes: [.image, .pdf],
    maxSize: 10_485_760,
    maxFiles: 5,
    currentCount: attached.count,
    hint: "Images or PDF, up to 10 MB each, 5 files max",
    labels: MonarchFileUploadLabels(title: "Drag and drop files here", browse: "Browse files")
) { accepted, _ in
    attached.append(contentsOf: accepted)
}

parityExceptions.reason: iOS names the accepted types as UTType values (.image, .pdf), not MIME patterns; the types are the same as the web's image/* and application/pdf.
parityExceptions.convention: Apple UniformTypeIdentifiers: file pickers filter by UTType.
